product_goal: A person with only iKant_LE GitHub source and a ChatGPT Edu Project types 'inizializza iKant'; the Project presents the exact source-owned admission and attempts source-executed iKant responses for subsequent human turns until owner-validated opt-out.

proof_levels.L0_PROJECT_SHELL: Installable from two objects; per-response diagnostic shell and terms workflow are conditional on successful source reads; native dispatch is not enforced.
proof_levels.L1_REAL_OWNER_TURN: Only source-exact Node execution and same-input owner receipt allow byte-exact Surface A.
proof_levels.L2_SESSION_REENTRY: Only an independently reopened durable writer receipt in a later human turn qualifies persistence.
proof_levels.L3_NATIVE_OR_H95: Native event and independent human field metrics remain external, separate proof gates.
